title: Green Rewards Card: Apply for a Sustainable Business Credit Card
summary: This document explains how to apply for the Green Rewards Card (Sustainable Business Credit Card), including eligibility (personal FICO minimum $690; business PAYDEX threshold 42 for established businesses), costs ($100 annual fee, 19.99% Purchase APR, 1.0% foreign transaction fee), and credit limits ($14,000–$75,000). It also covers required application details, online banking portal steps, and what happens after submission (activation, employee card controls, digital wallet setup).
